I farm here near Mwanza with my family, and this maize plot is small — only a bit of land close to home. I have no money to spare for fertilizer from the shop, and the rains here can be uncertain, so I do not want to waste shillings on inputs that may not pay back. I will put the manure from our animals on this plot because that costs me nothing, and I will plant the seed I kept from last year's harvest like my neighbors do. For the work, I will do most of it myself with my hoe, but when it is time to clear and weed I may ask someone to help me for a few days.
